setup.title: Welcome to {{app}}
setup.lead: {{app}} keeps life as a couple in one place: reminders, tasks, the weekly routine and the shopping list. Finance and Goals join in when you want them.
setup.createLead: Create the couple now and invite the other person whenever you like. Until then, the app works just for you.
setup.joinLead: Paste the code the other person sent to join the couple that already exists.

invite.title: Invite to your couple
invite.lead: Send this code. It is valid for 7 days and only one person can use it.

status.complete: Couple complete. Reminders reach both of you.
status.waiting: Your partner has not joined yet.

notes.name: Notes
notes.hint: Recipes, lists and ideas, only yours or the couple's.

reminders.name: Reminders
reminders.hint: Notes with a set time between the two of you.

finance.name: Finances
finance.offHint: The couple's expenses, settling up, bills and budget. You can turn it off any time without losing anything.

shopping.name: Shopping
shopping.hint: The home's single list, with a market mode.
